prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the green stone terraces of Machu Picchu with stone steps of normal height and low terrace walls, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult German woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, vivid copper-orange hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a tin barrel-shaped weight, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a gold cube-shaped block, a silver ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered rose-gold bracelets. Extra long nails in matching polished lapis lazuli.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide; a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle, the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape; a full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body polished lapis lazuli fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep royal-blue lapis surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID golden pyrite flecks scattered through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved lapis lazuli.

LEFT Cracks: the lapis lazuli body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right hip, and one chipped-off piece at her left shoulder, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw grey-blue stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the lapis lazuli is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
LEFT Pose: both arms slightly open away from her body, palms turned up, relaxed shoulders.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme peep-toe platform stiletto pumps in cream white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved lapis lazuli right down to the shoes.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Turkish man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, metallic gold glitter eyeshadow with defined lashes, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a gentle soft smile, cool ash-grey hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a bronze miniature anvil, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold rings. Extra long nails in matching polished carnelian.
RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body polished carnelian fused directly to his own form wrapping his whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow his body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING fiery orange-red carnelian surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID pale golden-orange banding flowing through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. His face and ears are real living skin, and his neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and his shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved carnelian.

RIGHT Cracks: the carnelian body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across his right forearm, and two chipped-off pieces, one at his right calf and one at his right shoulder, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw pale orange-brown stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including his chest, the carnelian is smooth, polished and whole, and his face, ears and neck are living skin.
RIGHT Pose: standing with both arms relaxed at his sides, palms turned slightly forward, head tilted a little.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
